actual.titulo: Hot Roads: The World's Most Dangerous Roads • The Sichuan-Tibet Highway
actual.descripcion: The Sichuan-Tibet Highway ║ The Sichuan Tibet Highway leads through landscapes and remote areas up to the Himalayan Mountains; accompanying truck driver Ren Taiping on his trip to the Tibetan capital city of Lhasa.

The BT2 ship travels to the Wohlenberger Wiek where divers Tobi and Andreas begin to clear a deep-sea area for later construction work; with millions of tons of WWII ammunition still lurking in the Baltic, it proves a risky job.

The BT2 explores Danish territorial waters with the help of the VALOR, an advanced Remotely Operated Vehicle; the device possesses first-class sensors, high-resolution cameras and a system that enables live images transmission directly to land.

Within sight of Rügen, the Baltic Sea divers drop anchor to salvage lost plastic "ghost nets," which can prove deadly traps for sea creatures; diver Erik acts cautiously around the wreck of the fishing cutter Friedrich Engels that sank in 1973.

Together with research divers, the Baltic Sea divers try to capture unique images of harbor porpoises looking for food; they work to salvage a 17-meter-long ship that sank deep into the silt of the harbor basin.
